added_lines: for more information please see notices boards. team hope christmas shoebox appeal would you like to give a little joy and love to a needy child this christmas? well you can, you can send them a christmas shoebox gift. explanation leaflets are available on the tables in the church. please return your filled shoe box to the parish office for collection before 10th november. share appeal sunday takes place next weekend 7th / 8th november. annual parish raffle christmas is fast approaching and we hope to hold our annual parish raffle, if there are any companies or parishioners who would like to donate or sponsor a prize for the raffle it would be gratefully appreciated. please contact the parish office, 01 4524702. mission sunday thank you to all who have contributed to our mission sunday collection on the weekend of the 17th / 18th october. triduum in honour of st. martin de porres sunday 1st to tuesday 3rd november. sunday 1st november (all saints day) 11 a.m. blessing of animals in the courtyard. 12.30 p.m. mass with speaker from st. carlo acutis ireland-novena prayer & blessing with st martin’s relic. monday 2nd november (all souls) 7 p.m. general healing mass with special healing prayers in the present of the relic of st carlo acutis. tuesday 3rd november (st martin’s feast day) 10 a.m mass novena prayer & blessing with st martin’s relic. 7 p.m feast day
